basic_details.job_title: UGB Concurrent Auditor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 10 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Uttarakhand Gramin Bank (UGB), Dehradun has invited applications from retired officers of Scale III to Scale V of UGB, SBI, any other RRB sponsored by SBI or any commercial bank for 10 Concurrent Auditor posts on contract for up to 12 months. Applications are sent by post or delivered by hand to The General Manager (Administration) at the Head Office in Dehradun. The last date for submission at that address is 15 December 2026.

qualification.details: The notice does not name any educational qualification. The official notification should be checked for the eligibility details of the post. | Home-centre: a fixed sum of Rs 40,000 per month. The auditor may claim reimbursement of travelling expenses not exceeding Rs 4,000 per month on the basis of a certificate or petrol bill. Non Home-centre: a fixed sum of Rs 45,000 per month. Stay expenses are reimbursable up to a maximum of Rs 12,000 per month on production of a rent agreement. Up to a maximum of Rs 6,000 per month can also be claimed for conveyance on an actual or certificate basis. TDS/Income Tax rules apply as per the IT Act. The remuneration was fixed with the approval of the Board.

selection_process: The notice says the process of selection is "As per policy guidelines" and describes no stage. It mentions that no TA/DA/Leave is granted for appearing in an interview. Selected auditors will form a pool with the Chief Inspector at Head Office.
important_instructions: The appointment initially stands for one year from the date of appointment. The agreement may be extended for the next 12 months on the same terms and conditions, subject to a satisfactory annual performance review. The proposed maximum tenure is 5 years, subject to annual review. The successful candidate must execute the Contract within the timeline and implement it from the specified date, once the Bank intimates acceptance of the application. The successful candidate signs an Agreement and must pay the required stamp duty as per Stamp laws in force in Uttarakhand. The Bank may cut or extend the timeline, accept or reject any application or all offers without assigning a reason, alter the schedule or change the process. No reimbursement of cost of any type will be paid to any person submitting an application. No TA/DA/Leave will be granted to a working or retired official for appearing in interview. More details are on the Bank's website www.ukgb.bank.in under "Careers" at the bottom.

content_sections.heading: About the Bank
content_sections.text: Uttarakhand Gramin Bank is a bank with its Head Office at 8 A, IT Park, Dehradun. The Concurrent Audit is to be conducted in selected branches, AMSHs and CPCs in and around ten centres. The selected auditors will form a pool available with the Chief Inspector at Head Office, who allocates the auditee units and gives the necessary instructions.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Download the application from the Bank's website www.ukgb.bank.in . The application format is also printed in the notice. Send it by post or deliver it by hand to: The General Manager (Administration), Uttarakhand Gramin Bank, Head Office – 8 A, IT PARK, Opposite SIDCUL, Sahastradhara Road, Dehradun - 248 013 The last date for submission at this address is 15.12.2026. Applications received after the last date will not be entertained. The notice does not mention an envelope superscription, a postal mode or an application email address. The application asks for these details: Name, father's name and date of birth. Bank and branch office from which the applicant retired, the post/scale held at retirement, and the date of retirement. A certificate in Annexure – A is required if the applicant did not retire from Uttarakhand Gramin Bank. PF No./Employee No., present residence with full postal address, permanent address, mobile/landline number and email ID. Educational qualification and JAIIB/CAIIB status. Details of the last 3 postings before retirement with dates. Experience in loans, audit or NPA follow-up, current work if any, and any disciplinary action during service. KYC details (Aadhaar No. and PAN No.), the period of medical leave in the year before retirement, and the full address of the usual place of residence if empanelled. Experience as Regional Manager or Branch Manager in years and months. The applicant also states that he or she agrees to work anywhere in the Bank's area of operation, and declares that the information is true, failing which the candidature may be cancelled.

Up to a maximum of Rs 6,000 per month can also be claimed for conveyance on an actual or certificate basis. TDS/Income Tax rules apply as per the IT Act. The remuneration was fixed with the approval of the Board.

faq.question: Q1. How many Concurrent Auditor posts has UGB announced?
faq.answer: UGB needs 10 Concurrent Auditors, one each at Uttarkashi, Tapovan (Tehri), Chamba, Pauri, Tilwara, Bhowali, Chinyanaula, Dwarahat, Bageshwar and Bharari.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications at the Head Office address is 15.12.2026. Applications received after that date will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the UGB Concurrent Auditor post?
faq.answer: Retired officers of Scale III to Scale V from UGB, SBI, any other RRB sponsored by SBI or any commercial bank can apply. They need at least 2 years as Branch Manager or Regional Manager.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The retired official should be below 69 years of age at the time of renewal of the contract.

faq.question: Q5. What is the remuneration?
faq.answer: The fixed remuneration is Rs 40,000 per month for a Home-centre and Rs 45,000 per month for a Non Home-centre. Reimbursements are separate: up to Rs 4,000 per month travel at a Home-centre, and up to Rs 12,000 stay plus up to Rs 6,000 conveyance at a Non Home-centre.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Download the application from www.ukgb.bank.in and send it by post or deliver it by hand to The General Manager (Administration), Uttarakhand Gramin Bank, Head Office – 8 A, IT PARK, Opposite SIDCUL, Sahastradhara Road, Dehradun - 248 013.

faq.question: Q7. Is the UGB Concurrent Auditor job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a contractual appointment for up to 12 months. It may be extended for a further 12 months on the same terms, subject to satisfactory annual review. The proposed maximum tenure is 5 years.

faq.question: Q8. Can an officer who is about to retire apply?
faq.answer: Yes, those going to superannuate within the next 6 months can also apply.

faq.question: Q9. Is there a gap limit between retirement and appointment?
faq.answer: Yes, the gap from superannuation to first appointment must not be more than 2 years. For later renewals there should not be a gap of one year.

faq.question: Q10. Who is not eligible?
faq.answer: Officers who were penalised in disciplinary proceedings in service, except punishment by way of censure, are not eligible. Neither are those on medical leave exceeding four months in the last year of service.
